title: Registry gate accepted document.write markup injection sinks

reproduction.beforeFix: Direct document.write() and a document alias calling writeln() returned pass from the source-isolation gate.
reproduction.afterFix: document.write() and document.writeln() calls on document, window.document, and statically resolved document aliases fail the source-isolation gate.

rootCause: The source gate rejected dynamic code and common innerHTML sinks but did not classify document.write()/writeln() as markup injection sinks.
remediation: Resolve direct, aliased, and computed browser document references in the TypeScript AST and reject write()/writeln() calls without executing submitted resource source.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "direct and aliased document.write"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: direct document.write and aliased document.writeln returned pass
validation.runtimeBoundary: This is local source-gate evidence. It does not replace isolated-preview and deployed CSP verification.
